research_report_write_protection.title: Research Report Write Protection
research_report_write_protection.content: Direct file writes (Python pathlib.write_text, bash cat/echo) to `.proma-research/<run>/` directories are blocked by Research Eval Isolation gates. To create a final report, you MUST use the `mcp__research__report_declare` MCP tool. Do not attempt to manually create REPORT.md in the run directory; the tool handles file generation and validation against prereg/journal state.

refinements.trigger: Recorded isolation constraint preventing direct writes to .proma-research run directories and mandating use of report_declare MCP tool.
refinements.evidence: The trajectory shows repeated failures when attempting to write REPORT.md directly to the protected .proma-research/e1-smoke-textbookM-s0/ directory using Python or bash, triggering 'Research Eval Isolation' errors. The correct procedure is to use the mcp__research__report_declare tool, which manages file creation and gate validation. This is a durable environmental constraint that should be preserved in local memory to prevent recurrence in this session's future research tasks.
refinements.outcome: Future attempts to finalize research reports in this session will correctly use report_declare instead of direct file I/O, avoiding isolation errors and saving token budget.
